items.statement: Bounded inference about discriminate pi-extension, molecular distortion and Lewis-acid coordination as explanations of PXX optical shifts while testing whether spectra identify a unique acid stoichiometry.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
